tools.name: robots
tools.description: Parses robots.txt for any domain — shows crawl rules, disallowed paths, sitemaps. Agents use this to check if they're allowed to scrape a site before doing it. [free]

tools.name: llms_txt
tools.description: Fetches and normalizes llms.txt / llms-full.txt from any site — the emerging standard for making websites readable to AI agents. [free]

tools.name: page_meta
tools.description: Extracts OG tags, canonical URL, title, and meta description from any web page. Useful for link previews, SEO audits, and content enrichment. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: domain_facts
tools.description: Live-checks a domain: is it up, does it have TLS, what's the title? Quick domain health check for agents evaluating links. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: link_graph
tools.description: Extracts all outbound links from a page, classified by domain. Shows where a page links to and which domains dominate. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Scrapes any public web page and returns clean structured JSON (title, text, length). The workhorse — agents use this for real data extraction. [price: $0.01/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: captcha_eval
tools.description: Classifies captcha type (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile) and difficulty. Eval only — we do NOT solve captchas. [price: $0.01/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: geo_time
tools.description: Geocode + timezone + currency context for any location string. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: entity_find
tools.description: Extracts named entities (people, companies, places) from text. Wikidata resolution next iteration. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: search_verify
tools.description: Checks if a URL supports a claim. Returns confidence score. Research agents use this to verify sources. [price: $0.01/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: similar_domains
tools.description: Finds similar/competitor domains by name-similarity. Lead-gen agents use this for prospecting. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: gas_now
tools.description: Current gas prices in Gwei for Base, Ethereum, or Arbitrum via public RPC. [free]

tools.name: chain_stats
tools.description: Block height + chain stats for Base or Ethereum. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: nonce
tools.description: Current transaction nonce for any address on Base or Ethereum. Agent tx bots need this before sending transactions. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: token_security
tools.description: Token security heuristics: honeypot signals, proxy detection, LP data. Trading agents use this to avoid rugs. [price: $0.01/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: ens_lookup
tools.description: ENS name resolution + reverse lookup via public Ethereum RPC. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Extractive summary (3 sentences) + top-5 keywords from any text. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: jsonify
tools.description: Coerces messy text (key=value lines, CSV-ish, sentences) into clean JSON. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: sentiment
tools.description: Sentiment classification (positive/negative/neutral) + emotion keyword hits. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: image_gen
tools.description: Generates 1 PNG from a text prompt (FLUX.1-dev, 512px). Async: returns job ID + poll URL. GPU-backed via RunPod ComfyUI, scale-to-zero. [price: $0.02/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: image_status
tools.description: Poll image-gen job status by job ID. Returns image base64 PNG when COMPLETED. [free]

tools.name: pii_guard
tools.description: Detects PII (emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards) in any text with character spans. Compliance agents use this before processing user data. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: prompt_guard
tools.description: Scores prompt-injection / jailbreak risk for LLM inputs. Agent builders use this to sanitize user inputs before hitting their LLM. [price: $0.01/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: hallucination_check
tools.description: Entailment scoring: does the provided context support this claim? Research agents use this to self-check outputs. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: json_guard
tools.description: Validates JSON, detects PII inside values, reports schema stats. Pipeline agents use this as a data-quality gate. [price: $0.001/call USDC via x402]

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: One verify-loop lane: confidence-labeled findings on any topic. The flagship teaser — full sweeps at $0.50-5 ship when this crosses BUILD. [price: $0.05/call USDC via x402]
